title: Which actions the assistant may take, and how they are confirmed
question: Which changes may the assistant make for a user (report schedules and recipients, issues and comments, asset stage changes, app navigation), from which surfaces (web chat, mobile, outside AI clients), and must each one be confirmed by a server-checked step rather than by the model's instructions?
context: Web chat creates and changes emailed report schedules with only a prompt-level confirmation for deletes (AI-REQ-018). The unreleased field tools require a server-checked confirmation in a later turn and can move up to 500 assets at once (AI-REQ-019). MCP is read-only by default (AI-REQ-016). App actions only change the screen (AI-REQ-020). The GiNEE roadmap lists human approval gates as future work.
